description:
The 25-year trading history and ISO9001 accreditation (held 12 consecutive years) suggest operational stability and genuine quality credentials. The 46% repeat customer rate is notably high for project-based work, indicating strong client relationships. The £1.7m/year European contract starting late 2025 provides meaningful near-term revenue visibility, and the second-tier management structure means the business isn't entirely dependent on the departing directors.
The gross margin trend is also encouraging, improving from 23% in FY22 to 34% in FY25, suggesting better job selection or pricing discipline over time.
